content: Make sure that the top cover back is inside of top cover front, I accidentally force open and broke the plastic of the back because one of the sides are not inside.

Use an Allen key short edge to measure from the end of the screw to the edge of the hinge. Mine measures about 11mm. When you open the lid you can see the spring compress. Too tight and it compresses completely and risk breaking the hing I guess. Too loose and the screw pops out of the hinge part fixed to the chassis.
The springs in these photos look way too tight. (Almost like the lid wouldn't function if they were tightened down this much.)

replies.content: Agree, did it like the photo and they were too tight.
